propositions: Three Copilot rebar skills silently fail to register due to frontmatter validation failures: rebar-implement (1327-char description exceeds 1024-char cap), rebar-janitor (1068-char description exceeds cap), rebar-debug (unquoted colon in plain scalar breaks YAML parse).
SKILL.md frontmatter descriptions must be converted to YAML folded block scalars and trimmed to ≤1024 characters while preserving each skill's /rebar-<name> invocation trigger.
A new deterministic CI lint script check_skill_frontmatter.py must validate all tracked SKILL.md files for valid YAML frontmatter, non-empty description ≤1024 chars, and name format compliance.
The lint check must be wired into the make lint target and backed by unit tests covering happy path and failure cases (over-cap, empty, unparseable, bad-name).
Copilot CLI enforces Agent Skills spec constraints but provides no error feedback when skills fail to register, requiring proactive repository-level validation.
